component.name: Dev Tunnels CLI
component.summary: Command-line client for Microsoft Dev Tunnels

description.p: Dev Tunnels CLI is the command-line client for Microsoft Dev Tunnels. It hosts a local port behind a public HTTPS URL or connects to an existing tunnel and forwards its ports back to the local machine, without opening any inbound firewall port on the local network.

ul.li: Host a local port and reach it over a persistent HTTPS tunnel URL
Connect to a tunnel and forward its ports to the local machine
Create, inspect, update, and delete tunnels from the command line
Manage tunnel ports and access control entries
Sign in with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft, or GitHub accounts
Inspect account limits and available service clusters
Diagnose connectivity with the built-in echo and ping commands
